subject.title: fix(signal): reject hex/exponent text-style span offsets

question: Should Signal container sends intentionally stop accepting hex, exponent, and fractional string spellings for text-style offsets?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and matches the upstream decimal grammar, but it deliberately narrows behavior that existing callers could have relied on through JavaScript coercion.

options.title: Accept strict decimal offsets
options.body: Land the PR as written because decimal integer offsets are the documented contract and malformed forms currently risk styling the wrong characters.

options.title: Preserve coercion compatibility
options.body: Keep accepting the old JavaScript numeric spellings, retaining undocumented behavior and the possibility of silently shifted spans.

recommendation.title: Accept strict decimal offsets
recommendation.body: Land the PR as written because decimal integer offsets are the documented contract and malformed forms currently risk styling the wrong characters.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the affected Signal container and send surfaces.
